ModMetaData.name: RimThreaded
ModMetaData.author: Major Hoff
ModMetaData.description:
RimThreaded enables RimWorld to utilize multiple threads and thus greatly increases the speed of the game.
UNOFFICIAL RimWorld 1.6 / 1.7 port by kazenokizu (Nolo) - https://github.com/kazenokizu/RimThreaded Not made or supported by the original author: report problems on the fork, not upstream. -Based on RimThreaded 2.7.2 (RimWorld 1.4) -1.7 (Waylith engine, .NET 10): built against 1.7.4982 rev1280; tested in unattended in-game runs on a real colony -1.6: built and patch-validated against 1.6.4871 rev590; not run in a live 1.6 game since the 1.7 fixes -Experimental: back up saves. Bug reports: Player.log + what happened, at https://github.com/kazenokizu/RimThreaded/issues
JOIN OUR COMMUNITY ON DISCORD: https://discord.gg/3JJuWK8
WIKI: https://github.com/cseelhoff/RimThreaded/wiki
MOD COMPATIBILITY: https://github.com/cseelhoff/RimThreaded/wiki/Mod-Compatibility
SETTINGS: The number of threads to utilize should be set in the mod settings, according to your specific computer's core count. If you are expiriencing "Thread Timeout" errors, try increasing your Thread Abort Timeout threshold.
LOAD ORDER: Put RimThreaded last in load order.
SUBMIT BUGS (this port): https://github.com/kazenokizu/RimThreaded/issues
